items.title: 'Claymore' Creator Norihiro Yagi Begins New Manga
items.summary: Norihiro Yagi, the creator of Claymore, began serializing a new manga titled Bartlet Fairy Basslet on the Shounen Jump+ platform on Monday. Yagi serialized Claymore in Monthly Shounen Jump from June 2001 to June 2007. Following the magazine's discontinuance, the manga switched to Jump SQ. in November 2007, where it ended in October 2014.
